name: RDW Livin Live!!

date.source: The post's own subject line and posting date.

matches.note: The Ruiner's RDW debut; won at 6:27.
Vulture jumped the guardrail and attacked Submarine's scheduled opponent, Tony Rudrick, before the bell; Submarine answered him instead. Won via Sonar Splash at 8:53.
Interference from Heavy Metal Joe and a returning Desperado punctuated the match; Watson won with the Rex Plex at 15:17.
Won via piledriver at 10:15, after a mystery interloper (later identified as heel debutant "Kold Blood" Kevin Kage attacking President Lee) cut Reggie Rock's throat open on the top rope mid-match.
Billed as the main event. The surviving capture ends mid-match with no finish transcribed — an honest results-free gap, not a withheld one.

notes: RDW's own first surviving card, establishing the fed's house style: a two-man broadcast team (President-persona Johnny Lee and color commentator Remy Wincott) trading constant in-fiction insults. Debuting heel "Kold Blood" Kevin Kage ambushes Lee mid-show, an angle without a match. Remy Wincott is credited elsewhere in the held record as a former titleholder in three other feds (AAW, BWA, ACW) before turning to broadcasting.

name: RDW Monday Mat Attack! [part3]

date.source: The post's own subject line and posting date.

matches.note: Broadcaster Remy Wincott left the table to attack Watson with a chair while "Too Sweet" Stevie Esquire broke Joe's own guitar over his head; ruled a no-contest/draw.
Billed as the second half of the show's "double main event." Won via Sonar Splash at 20:36.

notes: The post's own "[part3]" numbering implies two earlier "Monday Mat Attack" episodes; a targeted search of the full 1997 partition for that title returns only this one document — a standing capture gap, registered honestly rather than chased further.
